events.name: St. Louis Blues at Tampa Bay Lightning

headlines.description: — Darren Raddysh had a goal and two assists to reach 100 career points, and the Tampa Bay Lightning beat the St. Louis Blues 4-1 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Raddysh has goal, 2 assists to reach 100 career points as Lightning beat Blues 4-1

headlines.description: — Nikita Grebenkin had a goal and an assist, Carl Grundstrom also scored, and the Philadelphia Flyers beat the Vancouver Canucks 5-2 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Grebenkin, Grundstrom lead Flyers to 5-2 win over Canucks

headlines.description: — Jordan Eberle scored the tiebreaking goal midway through the third period and added an empty netter in the final minute, and the Seattle Kraken beat the Anaheim Ducks 3-1 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jordan Eberle scores 2 in 3rd period as Kraken beat Ducks 3-1

events.name: Columbus Blue Jackets at Los Angeles Kings

headlines.description: — Mason Marchment scored two power-play goals, Kirill Marchenko had one, and the Columbus Blue Jackets beat the Los Angeles Kings 3-1 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mason Marchment scores 2 power-play goals, Kirill Marchenko adds 1 as Blue Jackets beat Kings 3-1
